summary: Swedish Export Credit Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a legal opinion from CMS Wistrand regarding a $300 million tap of its Medium-Term Notes Series H Floating Rate Notes due November 2029, part of the same tranche as $500 million issued November 2025. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration (Form F-3). No special-situation event is present. The filing is a mechanical upsize of an existing note program with standard legal opinions and consents.
